author: werD5109
body: Hi, My username is werD5109. I was banned for "hacking: anti-knockback." I'm not sure exactly what that is, but I know for certain that I don't hack my Minecraft. I understand that sometimes staff, players and or plugins can incorrectly detect hacking, and that I was falsely accused of hacking. Please unban me because I love playing on the server and it really sucks if this is what will keep me from playing.

replies.author: werD5109
replies.body: I'm sorry, but I don't hack. I don't even know how to actually, my guess is that it was because I was sneaking and there was a block above me? I mean if you really think I should stay banned, then its up to you but I promise you I was not hacking. Again, this is my favorite server and I hate to be kicked off of it

replies.author: TheTNTPotato
replies.body:
Hello werD5109. I have reviewed the evidence, and it seems to clearly show you using Anti-Knockback. Even if you were sneaking/had a block above you, with the amount of hits the player got on you, you would have been knocked off eventually.

Appeal denied due to this being a valid infraction.
